studies.title: The Word of God
studies.purpose: To show the Bible is trustworthy
studies.central_truth: Claims ,Content & Consistency; God wants to commune with us

application.text: Scripture is an invitation to know God's character, not merely collect information.

response.text: Would you like to keep discovering what Scripture reveals about God?

studies.title: The Great Controversy
studies.purpose: To show there is a cosmic conflict between God and Satan, that planet Earth is its theatre and worship is its centre
studies.central_truth: Origin of evil, Outworking of evil & Obsolescence (end) of evil.

groups.label: God's answer and the end of evil
Why did God create Lucifer, and why did he rebel?
Why does genuine love require freedom?
Why does God allow evil to continue?
How does the cross answer the controversy?

application.text: Contrast God's love and compassion with coercion and rebellion.

response.text: What does the contrast between God's way and Satan's way show you about His character?

studies.title: The Work of the Holy Spirit
studies.purpose: To show how the spirit works on you & in you to bring about conversion.
studies.central_truth: The work of the Holy Spirit

application.text: Transformation involves the Spirit's work, not mere agreement with a doctrine.

response.text: Where might you invite the Holy Spirit to lead you?

studies.title: The Sanctuary
studies.purpose: To tell the story of redemption and reveal Gods plan to separate sinners from sin. (God is constant / Man is variable)
studies.central_truth: Jesus. How God deals with the separation problem.

groups.label: God seeks to dwell with us
How do the furnishings point to Christ?
What do the rooms and furnishings teach?
How do the stages of salvation relate?

application.text: God has moved toward us to restore the relationship damaged by sin.

response.text: What does God's desire to live close to you mean personally?

studies.title: The Plan of Salvation
studies.purpose: To show that salvation is by Grace alone through faith alone to the Glory of God alone.
studies.central_truth: The problem and the solution.

groups.label: God's love revealed at the cross

application.text: Grace is received, not earned; the cross reveals God's love.

response.text: How might you respond to God's gift of grace?

studies.title: The Law
studies.purpose: To demonstrate from scripture that God’s law is all about love and liberty, that is to be internally written rather than externally imposed and it is eternal.
studies.central_truth: The Decalogue.

groups.label: The law of love and liberty
Grace produces obedience from the heart
Is the law still relevant under the new covenant?
Does Christ as the end of the law abolish it?
What does it mean to die to the law?

application.text: Obedience is the fruit of salvation, not its price.

response.text: How would following Jesus from love differ from trying to earn His favour?

studies.title: Antichrist
studies.purpose: To identify the person and principle of antichrist.
studies.central_truth: Jesus is Christ and anyone who turns people from Jesus or attempts to occupy the place of Jesus is putting themselves in the place of Christ and is antichrist. Jesus only is our guide and anything and everything that scatters from him is antichrist.

groups.label: The meaning and spirit of antichrist
Does anti mean against or in place of?
What are the issues of worship and obedience?
How are the beasts and prophetic symbols interpreted?
What historical identifying characteristics are discussed?
Who were the ten horns and divided kingdoms?
What sources discuss persecution and prophetic time?
What claims about papal authority are quoted?
What is said about forgiveness of sins?
How can the teacher mark Bible references?

application.text: Keep loyalty to Jesus central, without directing hostility toward individual believers.

response.text: What would keeping Christ at the centre of your faith look like?

studies.title: The Seventy Week Prophecy
studies.purpose: To reveal the absolutely compelling evidence that Jesus Christ is the Messiah! To draw attention to an ancient prophecy that’s gives the key to unlock the most significant event this world has ever witnessed.
studies.central_truth: Daniel 9.

groups.label: What other evidence and details are given?

application.text: Prophecy is intended to strengthen confidence in Jesus as Messiah.

response.text: How do these Bible connections affect your confidence in Christ?

studies.title: Historicity of Jesus
studies.purpose: To examine non-Christian historical references to Jesus and the evidence for His ministry and the early Christian movement.
studies.central_truth: Historical sources and evidence surrounding the person of Jesus.

groups.label: What these sources say about Jesus
How does this relate to holiness and salvation?
Five points of Calvinism (placement for review)

application.text: Examine historical evidence carefully without fearing honest questions.

response.text: Would you like to examine the Gospels in the light of these historical sources?

studies.title: The Judgement
studies.purpose: The Judgement is to vindicate the Character of God.
studies.central_truth: In the Judgement, God is really on trial and not just us.

groups.label: The stages and participants of judgement

application.text: Consider the fairness and openness of God's judgement alongside Jesus' saving work.

response.text: What does God's commitment to justice mean to you?

studies.purpose: To show that the judgement is the culmination of the cross and that the final phase of Christs ministry in the heavenly sanctuary began in 1844.
studies.central_truth: The climax of the Gospel.

groups.label: How do Daniel 2, 7, 8 and 9 compare—and what does the 1844 controversy involve?

application.text: Jesus' ministry is presented as an expression of God's commitment to salvation and justice.

response.text: How does Christ's continuing ministry encourage your trust?

studies.title: America in Bible Prophecy
studies.purpose: To identify the second beast of Revelation 13.
studies.central_truth: The identification characteristics.

groups.label: What quotations concern religion and government?
What is said about church and state?
What is the historical Holy Office discussion?
What other political quotations are included?

application.text: True worship involves freedom of conscience rather than coercion.

response.text: How can we respect conscience while remaining faithful to our convictions?

studies.title: The Blue Stone:
studies.purpose: To explore the links presented between sanctuary imagery, prophecy and God's law, leading to our need of Jesus.
studies.central_truth: The law reveals God's righteousness and our need of a Saviour; obedience responds to grace.

groups.label: God's law leads us to Jesus

application.text: God's law reveals our need of Christ; it does not replace His grace.

response.text: How does the law point you toward Jesus rather than self-reliance?

studies.title: The Sabbath
studies.purpose: To demonstrate from scripture that the Sabbath is a memorial of both salvation & creation.
studies.central_truth: Jesus came to our world as the creator to re-create humanity in God’s image. By his life and death he finished the work of salvation and rested in the tomb on the Sabbath.

groups.label: What early Christian sources discuss Sunday?
How are the difficult passages interpreted?
What about Colossians and other texts?
What does the historical appendix say?

application.text: Sabbath rest points to our Creator and Redeemer, not earned salvation.

response.text: How might time with God deepen your relationship with Him?

studies.title: The Second Coming
studies.purpose: To show that the second coming of Christ is the pinnacle of salvation history and that it is literal, visible, audible and POWERFUL.
studies.central_truth: Jesus is coming to restore to deliver and to make an end of sin, pain and death.

groups.label: Will the coming be literal, visible and audible?
What about coming as a thief?

application.text: Christ's return offers hope that suffering and evil will end.

response.text: How does the promise of Jesus' return affect your hope?

studies.title: The Nature of Man
studies.purpose: To show that man does not possess immortality, life is found in Christ alone. To identify man’s soul and what happens when we die.
studies.central_truth: Jesus holds the keys of hell and death that unlocks the mystery of these important subjects. Jesus’ death loses its mystery and its sting and becomes a blessed rest on the journey home.

groups.label: How should difficult passages about death be understood?

application.text: Hope in life after death rests in Christ and His resurrection promise.

response.text: How does the resurrection promise speak to your experience of loss?

studies.title: The Mark of the Beast
studies.purpose: To identify the Beast and its Mark.
studies.central_truth: Jesus alone is worthy of our Worship and Allegiance, for he is our God, Creator and Redeemer.

groups.label: What sources discuss the Sabbath and Sunday?
What other historical sources are cited?
What claims are made about enforcement?
What else does the historical appendix contain?

application.text: Allegiance to Jesus matters more than condemnation of other people.

response.text: Whose authority do you trust when your convictions are challenged?

studies.title: The Millennium
studies.purpose: To explain millennium and purpose – What happens during and after it.
studies.central_truth: The Goodness of God, seen at the cross is demonstrated in the Millennium Judgement.

application.text: God's final resolution of evil is presented as fair and transparent.

response.text: What picture of God's fairness emerges from this study?

studies.title: Hell – Is God a Sadist?
studies.purpose: To show that the purpose of Hell is to destroy sin forever.
studies.central_truth: God’s righteousness.

groups.label: What does Scripture say about hell?
God's character and the end of sin
What about the rich man and Lazarus?
Does forever always mean endless duration?
What does the great gulf mean?

application.text: God's judgement should be considered alongside His desire to end suffering.

response.text: What picture of God's character emerges from these passages?

studies.title: The Gift of Prophecy
studies.purpose: To show how God does everything in his power to guide us thru the gift of prophecy.
studies.central_truth: Jesus Christ gives the right message at the right time.

groups.label: How should prophetic writings be tested?

application.text: Prophetic guidance must deepen trust in Jesus and be tested against Scripture.

response.text: How can you be open to guidance while remaining grounded in the Bible?

studies.title: The Remnant Church
studies.purpose: To Discover which Church is theremnant church of the last days.
studies.central_truth: Since JESUS gives his life his sheep follow him wherever he goes.

groups.label: What difficult texts concern the church?

application.text: Belonging to God's people means following Jesus and treating others with love.

response.text: What does it mean to follow the Shepherd wherever He leads?

studies.title: Christian living
studies.purpose: To explore the topic of adornment and to find out how much is too much.
studies.central_truth: Jewellery and other associated material.

application.text: Christian choices should flow from a changed heart rather than mere appearance.

response.text: What priorities might Christ be inviting you to reconsider?

studies.title: Prayer
studies.purpose: Prayer is powerful, effectual, and necessary for the disciple of Christ. There are certain conditions that will ensure that our prayers are heard.
studies.central_truth: Prayer is how we communicate with our saviour.

groups.label: What about faith and unanswered prayer?

application.text: Prayer is trustful relationship with God, not a method of controlling outcomes.

response.text: What would you like to bring to God in prayer?

studies.title: Health
studies.purpose: To show our bodies are the temple of the Holy Spirit. As our creator, redeemer and father, God is intimately concerned with the health of the whole person-body, mind & spirit.
studies.central_truth: Jesus Christ came so that we may have life & life more abundantly.

groups.label: What about Paul's advice and dietary liberty?

application.text: Caring for health expresses gratitude and stewardship rather than human worth.

response.text: What practical step toward healthier living would you consider?

studies.title: Baptism
studies.purpose: To show the ritual/ceremony of Baptism is a symbol of the turning away from sin and a turning to the Lord.
studies.central_truth: Baptism by immersion.

groups.label: The example and meaning of baptism

application.text: Baptism represents turning from sin and beginning a life of discipleship.

response.text: What further step of following Jesus might you take?

studies.title: The Godhead
studies.purpose: To show the Father, Son and the Holy Spirit are a unity of 3 co-eternal persons.
studies.central_truth: Jesus, Love and unity

groups.label: The Spirit and the unity of the Godhead
What does Scripture say about Christ's divinity?

application.text: Knowledge about the Godhead should deepen love, worship and trust.

response.text: What have you discovered about the Father, Son and Holy Spirit?

studies.title: Stewardship
studies.purpose: Everything belongs to God; as stewards we are responsible to Him for all that He has entrusted to us.
studies.central_truth: Jesus Christ gave all for us and calls us to be fully surrendered to Him.

application.text: Stewardship reflects gratitude for what God has entrusted to us.

response.text: How might God's generosity change your use of resources and time?

studies.title: Witnessing
studies.purpose: To show that every true disciple of Christ is born into the kingdom of God as a missionary.
studies.central_truth: Jesus.

application.text: Witnessing flows from personally knowing and following Jesus.

response.text: Who might benefit from hearing what Jesus has done in your life?
